text: 据央视财经，随着中国电影市场持续升温，行业发展逻辑也在持续迭代升级。站在资本市场视角，内容质量、IP长线运营能力、出品方多元化布局、AI业务落地成效，已成为机构评判影视上市公司价值的重要标准。 近期，A股影视传媒板块关注度持续提升。多家机构发布观点，伴随视频大模型迭代成熟，AI已经不再局限概念探索，逐步落地到动画电影、微短剧、后期渲染、数字人等真实业务场景，部分企业已经实现AI业务收入兑现。 梳理券商研报发现，机构普遍看好两大方向。一是传统影视龙头的AI改造，二是AI短剧、AI漫剧赛道。 不过，业内人士也提示，赛道火热的同时，当前行业仍面临版权界定、内容
text_en: According to CCTV Finance, as China's film market continues to heat up, the industry's development logic is also continuously iterating and upgrading. From a capital market perspective, content quality, long-term IP operation capability, diversified production layout, and AI business implementation results have become key criteria for institutions to evaluate listed film and TV companies. Recently, attention on the A-share film and media sector has continued to rise. Multiple institutions have issued views that, with the maturation of video large model iterations, AI is no longer limited to conceptual exploration but has gradually landed in real business scenarios such as animated films, micro-dramas, post-production rendering, and digital avatars, with some companies already realizing AI business revenue. Reviewing broker research reports, institutions generally favor two main directions: first, the AI transformation of traditional film and TV leaders, and second, the AI short-drama and AI comic-drama track. However, industry insiders also caution that while the sector is hot, the industry still faces challenges such as copyright definition and content
